maddeler.e:
افتعلت (form VIII)
# اِفْتَعَلْتُ (iftaʕaltu) /if.ta.ʕal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# اِفْتَعَلْتَ (iftaʕalta) /if.ta.ʕal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# اِفْتَعَلْتِ (iftaʕalti) /if.ta.ʕal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# اِفْتَعَلَتْ (iftaʕalat) /if.ta.ʕa.lat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
